description: Installation, testing, maintenance, and fault diagnosis of low-voltage domestic, commercial, and small industrial wiring systems, switchgear, distribution boards, and backup inverter systems.
daily_tasks: Cutting wall chasing for concealed PVC conduits
Pulling multi-strand copper cables using steel wire fish snakes
Terminating MCB distribution boards and busbars
Wiring modular switches, sockets, and fan regulators
Diagnosing short circuits and tripping MCBs
Measuring voltage and continuity with digital multimeters
Installing ceiling fans, tube lights, and exhaust fans
advanced_tasks: Designing balanced load distribution across 3-phase supply panels
Constructing chemical/salt-charcoal earthing pits and measuring earth resistance (< 5 ohms)
Diagnosing floating neutral conditions in 3-phase 4-wire domestic systems
Rewinding ceiling fan single-phase induction stator coils
materials: FR/FRLS copper flexible wires (1.0, 1.5, 2.5, 4.0, 6.0 sq mm)
Rigid PVC conduit pipes and solvent
work_processes: Conduit Chasing -> Pipe Layout -> Wire Pulling -> DB Dressing -> Switchboard Fitting -> Continuity Test -> Power Energization -> Load Verification
troubleshooting_tasks: Tracing neutral-to-ground leakage causing RCCB nuisance tripping
Isolating phase-to-neutral short circuits in concealed wall junction boxes
Detecting burnt or high-resistance neutral terminals causing voltage fluctuations
Replacing faulty 2.5 uF ceiling fan run capacitors
quality_inspection: Verifying correct wire color coding (Red/Yellow/Blue Phase, Black Neutral, Green Earth)
Checking tight mechanical terminal screws to prevent arching
Testing 230V AC phase-neutral voltage and < 2V neutral-earth voltage
Ensuring MCB amperage matches downstream wire ampacity
measurement_and_planning: Total connected load wattage calculation for ACs, geysers, and appliances
Sizing conduit diameter based on wire fill capacity (max 40% fill)
safety_practices: Mandatory de-energization and lockout before working on live busbars
Double-checking circuit isolation with calibrated phase tester
Zero naked twisted joints inside concealed conduits
maintenance: Inspecting distribution boards for thermal discolouration
Testing RCCB trip test buttons monthly
Adding water/saline solution to earthing pits before summer months
customer_communication: Explaining safety rationale for RCCB and proper earthing to homeowners
Quoting point-based vs running-foot wiring estimates
Advising on energy-saving BLDC fans and LED fixtures

official_vocational_references.ssc: Electronics Sector Skills Council of India

canonical_skills: Concealed Wall Conduit Chasing and Installation
Miniature Circuit Breaker (MCB) Distribution Board Wiring
Multimeter Phase and Neutral Voltage Diagnostics
Electrical Cable Pulling and Terminal Termination
Earth Resistance Verification and Earthing Pit Setup
